To add your first product in Kaizena Flow, open the Products section in your store admin, then press "Add product." Enter a title, a price, and upload a picture for the product. After filling in these details, press "Save" to add the product. If you want, I can guide you to the exact place in the admin.

I can help you with instructions from the documentation on how to delete every product in your store named e2e-shop. For a store management task like this, are you running the store yourself or are you a developer building on Kaizena Flow?

The 401 error on GET /products means the token is missing, unknown, or revoked according to the docs on authentication errors. Please check that you use the right Admin API token, that it is active and correctly included in the request authorization header. Never share your real API token in chats or public. If this does not solve it, the docs can guide you through authentication setup or token management, or you may contact Kaizena Flow support.
